quality_gate.criterion: No lower actual purpose score per matched game/profile/seed than the existing corresponding adaptive mode. Descriptive finite-case acceptance, not universal strength proof.

rejected_design.reason: Waiting for four forecast comparisons before allowing any experience disabled prior adaptation.
rejected_design.resolution: Keep existing adaptive fallback and forgetting unchanged; empirical forecast scores are diagnostic only. Gate additional hypotheses on both response prediction and known-rule immediate-purpose choice comparisons.

prediction_only_second_attempt.reason: Forecast improvement did not imply stronger decisions; revoking all empirical adaptation also harmed strength. Seeds20/21 are now development.

combat_identity.scope: exact route/action lifecycle identity, not improved combat intelligence or calibrated future-value learning

extra_model_validation.conclusion: No extra-model adoption in these episodes; integration preserves existing strength but does not demonstrate a strength gain.
extra_model_validation.checkpoint_control_fields: Defaults actually used by measured actors added; every final-source lifecycle replayed afterward.
